name: gemskills
description: Multi-provider AI media skills. Image, video, and edit generation across Google (Nano Banana Pro / Gemini 3 Pro Image, Veo 3.1), OpenAI (gpt-image-2), and xAI (Grok Imagine image + grok-imagine-video-1.5), with capability-aware auto-pick and a /gemskills:setup onboarding flow.
